Mamata Banerjee Challenges Election Commission Order in Supreme Court

Mamata Banerjee has filed a petition in the Supreme Court challenging a decision by the Election Commission. The petition challenges the freezing of her party's name and election symbol. The Supreme Court has granted an urgent hearing for the petition.
